name: Random._randbelow_without_getrandbits
note: review: randbelowWithout drops the warn(...) of :262-265 (its docstring says it \"has no effect on the result\"), but for n >= 2**53 CPython always issues that UserWarning, and under an error filter raises it before any draw (probe: Sub(5)._randbelow(2**60) under simplefilter('error') raises UserWarning, state unchanged), so the n >= 2**53 half of RandbelowWithoutExact (\"floor(u * float(n)) after one draw\") is false there; the n < 2**53 half (first u below the correctly rounded limit, then floor(u * 2**53) % n) is exact.
